problems.group: Timing Chain & Tensioner Wear / Oil Dilution
problems.h4: Timing Chain & Tensioner Wear / Oil Dilution - Why the Land Rover Defender 130 D250 204DTD Suffers Premature Wear
problems.rootCause: The timing chain tensioner can lose pressure over time, while frequent short journeys or heavy towing can lead to incomplete DPF regeneration, causing fuel wash and oil dilution.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the chain, guides, and updated tensioners, alongside flushing diluted oil.
repairOptions.longevity: Effective for early-stage symptoms; prevents catastrophic bottom-end wear.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the engine has suffered catastrophic timing failure or block damage.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Defender 130 D250 (L663) is worth £55,000-£75,000+ `[THIRD-PARTY]`. At this value, a rebuilt engine replacement cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's overall value, making replacement highly viable to preserve the asset.
problems.recommendation: If the issue is strictly early-stage DPF/oil dilution, a specialist service, software update, and oil flush is the most cost-effective fix. However, if there is accompanying timing chain rattle, loss of compression, or internal damage, a fully rebuilt unit with all known vulnerabilities addressed is the safest long-term choice for a vehicle of this caliber.
